documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management reported a strong financial performance for FY26 with a 75.05% year-on-year increase in consolidated total income to INR322.64 crores and a net profit rise of 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, driven by owned fleet expansion and disciplined execution. During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis and signed a five-year contract with Hardy Oil, while also purchasing a multi-purpose support vessel (MPSV) from South Africa. Looking ahead, management remains optimistic about sector opportunities from the Maritime India Vision 2030 and expects around a 10% increase in turnover for FY27. ABS Marine Services Limited released its investor presentation for the half year and year ended March 31, 2026, highlighting a consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26. Management discussed operational achievements including the induction of OSV 'HADES' and an MPSV vessel, alongside ongoing execution of contracts with government bodies and oil majors like ONGC.

guidance.claim: Management expects approximately a 10% increase in turnover from current levels for the current financial year FY27, assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to continue in the band of 45% to 50%.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes that ONGC is preparing a tender for about 20 vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent a total of about $15 million for both the new vessels, Hades and MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: On a consolidated basis for FY26, total income grew by 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores, EBITDA increased by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year. EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: For H2 FY26, consolidated total income grew by 78.93% year-on-year to INR183.11 crores, EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, and EBITDA margin expanded by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year. EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet with offices supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: Out of the eight vessels the company owns, five are on long-term charter, two have just come out of charter, and a third newly acquired one is going into dry dock.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: Top 10 clients contribute around 90 percent of the company's revenue.
The company holds over INR 350 Cr in strategic contracts secured.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the debt-equity ratio is comfortable for banks to lend, and funding is not seen as a problem.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side. With adequate reserves and all, I think bankers are comfortable for lending at this point of time. With Bankers comfortable with the current debt-equity ratio ,we don't see funding will be a problem at this point of time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that exchange rate movements from INR82 per dollar to INR96 have impacted the acquisition cost of vessels.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96. So, that is playing on the cost of the vessel.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the vessel AM Passion is fixed at $16,000 per day for three years with Schlumberger, and for the next three years it will be at $19,000.
management_commitments.quote: And then as of now, we are getting about $16,000 per day and that is fixed for three years. And then the next three years, it will be at $19,000. That is, I am talking about Passion.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects tax rates for FY27 to be around a maximum of 1.5% to 2%.
management_commitments.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that it stays committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
